CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION funding_control.can(a uuid, o uuid, s uuid, ac uuid, op text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$

 SELECT funding_control.member_role(a,o,s) IS NOT NULL AND (funding_control.member_role(a,o,s)='owner' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funding_control.permissions p WHERE p.org=o AND p.store=s AND p.account=ac AND p.actor=a AND p.operation=op))

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION funding_canonical.scope_role(a uuid, o uuid, s uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$

 SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN min(m.role) ELSE NULL END FROM public.org_memberships m

 JOIN public.organizations org ON org.id=m.organization_id AND org.is_active IS TRUE

 JOIN public.stores st ON st.organization_id=org.id AND st.id=s AND st.is_active IS TRUE

 WHERE m.user_id=a AND m.organization_id=o AND m.is_active IS TRUE

 AND (m.role IN ('owner','admin') OR (m.role IN ('staff','cashier') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.org_membership_stores ms WHERE ms.membership_id=m.id AND ms.store_id=s)))

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION funding_canonical.read(o uuid, s uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$

DECLARE a uuid:=auth.uid();result jsonb;

BEGIN

 IF funding_canonical.scope_role(a,o,s) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN'; END IF;

 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'organizationId',r.organization_id,'storeId',r.store_id,'currency',r.currency,'currencyRevision',r.currency_revision,

 'amount',r.amount::text,'spent',r.spent::text,'returned',r.returned::text,'outstanding',CASE WHEN r.status IN ('DRAFT','APPROVED','CANCELLED','REVERSED') THEN '0' ELSE (r.amount-r.spent-r.returned)::text END,

 'status',r.status,'revision',r.revision,'responsibleName',r.responsible_id::text,'purpose',r.purpose,'sourceName',r.source_account::text,'occurredAt',r.occurred_at) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id) INTO result

 FROM stock_funding.advances r WHERE r.organization_id=o AND r.store_id=s AND (funding_control.can(a,o,s,r.source_account,'VIEW') OR (r.created_by=a AND funding_control.can(a,o,s,r.source_account,'REQUEST')));

 RETURN coalesce(result,'[]'::jsonb);

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION funding_canonical.custody_event(uuid, text, uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CUSTODY_WRITE_CONTRACT_NOT_BOUND'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION funding_canonical.positions(o uuid, s uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$

DECLARE a uuid:=auth.uid();result jsonb;

BEGIN

 IF funding_canonical.scope_role(a,o,s) IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN'; END IF;

 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) INTO result FROM (

 SELECT r.currency,sum(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('FUNDED','PARTIALLY_RECONCILED','RECONCILED','REVERSED') THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END)::text AS issued,

 sum(r.spent)::text AS purchased,sum(r.returned)::text AS returned,

 sum(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('FUNDED','PARTIALLY_RECONCILED') THEN r.amount-r.spent-r.returned ELSE 0 END)::text AS outstanding

 FROM stock_funding.advances r WHERE r.organization_id=o AND r.store_id=s AND funding_control.can(a,o,s,r.source_account,'VIEW') GROUP BY r.currency) x;

 RETURN coalesce(result,'[]'::jsonb);

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.allocate_field_wallet_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_membership_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_wallet_id uuid;
  v_before numeric := 0;
  v_after numeric := 0;
  v_cycle_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if p_store_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_store_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'p_membership_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_amount is null or p_amount <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Amount must be greater than zero';
  end if;

  select s.organization_id
    into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id
    and s.store_type = 'FIELD_PROCUREMENT'
    and coalesce(s.is_active, true) = true;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid Field Procurement store';
  end if;

  select m.role
    into v_actor_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_actor_role not in ('owner', 'admin') then
    raise exception 'Only owner/admin can allocate field wallet funds';
  end if;

  select c.id
    into v_cycle_id
  from public.field_cycles c
  where c.store_id = p_store_id
    and c.status = 'OPEN'
  order by c.opened_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_cycle_id is null then
    raise exception 'NO_ACTIVE_FIELD: Open a field cycle before allocating money';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_memberships m
    join public.org_membership_stores ms on ms.membership_id = m.id
    where m.id = p_membership_id
      and m.organization_id = v_org_id
      and ms.store_id = p_store_id
      and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  ) then
    raise exception 'Target member is not assigned to this store';
  end if;

  insert into public.field_wallets (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    membership_id,
    balance,
    created_by,
    is_active
  )
  values (
    v_org_id,
    p_store_id,
    p_membership_id,
    0,
    auth.uid(),
    true
  )
  on conflict (store_id, membership_id)
  do nothing;

  select w.id, w.balance
    into v_wallet_id, v_before
  from public.field_wallets w
  where w.store_id = p_store_id
    and w.membership_id = p_membership_id
    and w.organization_id = v_org_id
  for update;

  v_after := coalesce(v_before, 0) + p_amount;

  update public.field_wallets
  set
    balance = v_after,
    updated_at = now(),
    is_active = true
  where id = v_wallet_id;

  insert into public.field_wallet_transactions (
    wallet_id,
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    membership_id,
    field_cycle_id,
    type,
    amount,
    balance_before,
    balance_after,
    note,
    created_by
  )
  values (
    v_wallet_id,
    v_org_id,
    p_store_id,
    p_membership_id,
    v_cycle_id,
    'ALLOCATE',
    p_amount,
    coalesce(v_before, 0),
    v_after,
    nullif(trim(coalesce(p_note, '')), ''),
    auth.uid()
  );

  return v_wallet_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_inventory_movement_notification_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_title text;
  v_product_name text;
  v_sku text;
begin
  select p.name, p.sku
  into v_product_name, v_sku
  from public.products p
  where p.id = new.product_id
  limit 1;

  v_title :=
    case
      when coalesce(new.delta, 0) > 0 then 'New Stock Received'
      else 'Stock Reduced'
    end;

  insert into public.notifications (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    source_store_id,
    event_type,
    title,
    body,
    items,
    total_units,
    total_skus,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_name,
    ref_movement_id,
    created_by,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.store_id,
    null,
    case when coalesce(new.delta, 0) > 0 then 'STOCK_IN' else 'STOCK_OUT' end,
    v_title,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'inventory_movements',
      'reason', new.reason,
      'movement_id', new.id
    ),
    jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id', new.product_id,
        'product_name', coalesce(v_product_name, 'Product'),
        'sku', v_sku,
        'qty', abs(coalesce(new.delta, 0))
      )
    ),
    abs(coalesce(new.delta, 0)),
    1,
    auth.uid(),
    null,
    new.id,
    auth.uid(),
    now()
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_notification_from_stock_movement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.notifications (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    source_store_id,
    event_type,
    title,
    body,
    items,
    total_units,
    total_skus,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_name,
    ref_movement_id,
    created_by,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.store_id,
    new.store_id,
    case when new.mode = 'ADD' then 'STOCK_IN' else 'STOCK_OUT' end,
    case when new.mode = 'ADD' then 'New Stock Received' else 'Stock Reduced' end,

    jsonb_build_object(
      'message', coalesce(new.note, 'Stock update'),
      'mode', new.mode,
      'amount', new.amount,
      'product_id', new.product_id
    ),

    jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id', new.product_id,
        'qty', new.amount,
        'mode', new.mode
      )
    ),
    new.amount,
    1,
    new.created_by,
    null,
    new.id,
    new.created_by,
    now()
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_stock_movement_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_product_name text;
  v_sku text;
  v_unit text;
  v_category text;
  v_title text;
  v_event_type text;
  v_qty numeric;
  v_event_id uuid;
begin
  v_qty := abs(coalesce(new.amount, 0));

  if v_qty <= 0 or new.product_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  -- Business-event identity:
  -- inbound batch/partial receive -> shared event_id
  -- ordinary movement          -> movement id
  v_event_id := coalesce(new.event_id, new.id);

  select
    p.name,
    p.sku,
    p.unit,
    p.category
  into
    v_product_name,
    v_sku,
    v_unit,
    v_category
  from public.products p
  where p.id = new.product_id
    and p.organization_id = new.organization_id
  limit 1;

  if upper(coalesce(new.mode, '')) in (
    'ADD',
    'IN',
    'STOCK_IN',
    'RECEIVE',
    'RECEIVED',
    'PURCHASE',
    'INBOUND'
  ) then
    v_title := 'New Stock Received';
    v_event_type := 'STOCK_IN';
  else
    v_title := 'Stock Reduced';
    v_event_type := 'STOCK_OUT';
  end if;

  -- Idempotency remains movement-level.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.notifications n
    where n.ref_movement_id = new.id
    limit 1
  ) then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.notifications (
    organization_id,
    store_id,
    source_store_id,
    event_type,
    title,
    body,
    items,
    total_units,
    total_skus,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_name,
    ref_movement_id,
    created_by,
    created_at,
    event_id
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.store_id,
    null,
    v_event_type,
    v_title,

    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'stock_movements',
      'mode', new.mode,
      'note', new.note,
      'movement_id', new.id,
      'event_id', v_event_id,
      'product_id', new.product_id,
      'product_name',
        coalesce(
          nullif(v_product_name, ''),
          'Unknown Product'
        )
    ),

    jsonb_build_array(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id', new.product_id,
        'product_name',
          coalesce(
            nullif(v_product_name, ''),
            'Unknown Product'
          ),
        'name',
          coalesce(
            nullif(v_product_name, ''),
            'Unknown Product'
          ),
        'sku', v_sku,
        'unit', v_unit,
        'category', v_category,
        'qty', v_qty
      )
    ),

    v_qty,
    1,
    coalesce(new.created_by, auth.uid()),
    null,
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.created_by, auth.uid()),
    coalesce(new.created_at, now()),
    v_event_id
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_field_wallet_history_by_cycle_v1(p_store_id uuid, p_cycle_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, type text, amount numeric, purpose text, category text, note text, agent_email text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    t.id::uuid,
    t.type::text,
    coalesce(t.amount, 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(t.purpose, 'OPERATIONAL')::text,
    coalesce(t.category, 'OTHER')::text,
    t.note::text,
    coalesce(u.email, '')::text,
    t.created_at::timestamptz
  from public.field_wallet_transactions t
  left join public.org_memberships m on m.id = t.membership_id
  left join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
  where t.store_id = p_store_id
    and t.field_cycle_id = p_cycle_id
  order by t.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_field_wallet_history_v1(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, field_cycle_id uuid, type text, amount numeric, purpose text, category text, note text, agent_email text, created_at timestamp with time zone, item_name text, unit text, quantity numeric, actual_unit_price numeric, normalized_unit text, normalized_quantity numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_membership_id uuid;
  v_role text;
  v_can_manage boolean := false;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select m.id, lower(coalesce(m.role, ''))
    into v_membership_id, v_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  join public.stores s on s.organization_id = m.organization_id
  where s.id = p_store_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'No access to this store';
  end if;

  v_can_manage := v_role in ('owner', 'admin');

  return query
  select
    t.id::uuid,
    t.field_cycle_id::uuid,
    t.type::text,
    coalesce(t.amount, 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(t.purpose, 'OPERATIONAL')::text,
    coalesce(t.category, 'GENERAL')::text,
    t.note::text,
    coalesce(u.email, '—')::text,
    t.created_at::timestamptz,

    t.item_name::text,
    t.unit::text,
    coalesce(t.quantity, 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(t.actual_unit_price, 0)::numeric,

    case
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('g', 'gram', 'grams') then 'gram'
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('kg', 'kilogram', 'kilograms') then 'gram'
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('ton', 'tons', 'tani') then 'kg'
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('piece', 'pcs', 'pc') then 'piece'
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('sack', 'bag') then 'sack'
      else lower(coalesce(t.unit, ''))
    end::text,

    case
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('g', 'gram', 'grams') then coalesce(t.quantity, 0)
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('kg', 'kilogram', 'kilograms') then coalesce(t.quantity, 0) * 1000
      when lower(coalesce(t.unit, '')) in ('ton', 'tons', 'tani') then coalesce(t.quantity, 0) * 1000
      else coalesce(t.quantity, 0)
    end::numeric
  from public.field_wallet_transactions t
  left join public.org_memberships m on m.id = t.membership_id
  left join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
  where t.store_id = p_store_id
    and (v_can_manage or t.membership_id = v_membership_id)
  order by t.created_at desc
  limit 500;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_field_wallet_summary_v1(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(wallet_id uuid, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, membership_id uuid, agent_email text, agent_role text, balance numeric, total_allocated numeric, total_purchases numeric, total_expenses numeric, total_adjustments numeric, last_activity_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_actor_membership_id uuid;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_cycle_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select s.organization_id
  into v_org_id
  from public.stores s
  where s.id = p_store_id
    and s.store_type = 'FIELD_PROCUREMENT'
    and coalesce(s.is_active, true) = true;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invalid Field Procurement store';
  end if;

  select m.id, m.role
  into v_actor_membership_id, v_actor_role
  from public.org_memberships m
  where m.organization_id = v_org_id
    and m.user_id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(m.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if v_actor_membership_id is null then
    raise exception 'Not a member of this organization';
  end if;

  select c.id
  into v_cycle_id
  from public.field_cycles c
  where c.store_id = p_store_id
    and c.status = 'OPEN'
  order by c.opened_at desc
  limit 1;

  -- ✅ No active field = no old wallet summary
  if v_cycle_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    w.id,
    w.organization_id,
    w.store_id,
    w.membership_id,
    coalesce(u.email, '—')::text,
    coalesce(m.role, 'staff')::text,
    coalesce(w.balance, 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'ALLOCATE'), 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'PURCHASE'), 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'EXPENSE'), 0)::numeric,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.type = 'ADJUST'), 0)::numeric,
    max(t.created_at)
  from public.field_wallets w
  join public.org_memberships m on m.id = w.membership_id
  left join auth.users u on u.id = m.user_id
  join public.field_wallet_transactions t
    on t.wallet_id = w.id
   and t.field_cycle_id = v_cycle_id
  where w.store_id = p_store_id
    and w.organization_id = v_org_id
    and (
      v_actor_role in ('owner', 'admin')
      or w.membership_id = v_actor_membership_id
    )
  group by w.id, w.organization_id, w.store_id, w.membership_id, u.email, m.role, w.balance
  order by max(t.created_at) desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_inventory_movements(p_store_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, store_id uuid, product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, unit text, category text, qty_change integer, mode text, note text, actor_user_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    sm.id,
    sm.store_id,
    sm.product_id,
    coalesce(p.name, 'Product') as product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.unit,
    p.category,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) = 'ADD' then abs(coalesce(sm.amount, 0))::integer
      when upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) = 'REDUCE' then -abs(coalesce(sm.amount, 0))::integer
      else coalesce(sm.amount, 0)::integer
    end as qty_change,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) = 'ADD' then 'ADD'
      when upper(coalesce(sm.mode, '')) = 'REDUCE' then 'REDUCE'
      else coalesce(sm.mode, 'ADJUST')
    end as mode,
    sm.note,
    sm.created_by as actor_user_id,
    sm.created_at
  from public.stock_movements sm
  left join public.products p
    on p.id = sm.product_id
   and p.organization_id = sm.organization_id
  where sm.store_id = p_store_id
  order by sm.created_at desc
  limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_store_inventory_movements(p_store_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organization_id uuid, store_id uuid, product_id uuid, product_name text, mode text, amount integer, qty_change integer, note text, actor_user_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    m.id,
    m.organization_id,
    m.store_id,
    m.product_id,
    p.name as product_name,
    m.mode,
    m.amount,
    m.qty_change,
    m.note,
    m.actor_user_id,
    m.created_at
  from public.inventory_movements m
  left join public.products p on p.id = m.product_id
  where m.store_id = p_store_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_memberships om
      where om.user_id = auth.uid()
        and om.organization_id = m.organization_id
        and om.is_active = true
    )
  order by m.created_at desc
  limit greatest(p_limit, 1);
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'

  select

    m.store_id,
    m.product_id,
    p.name as product_name,
    m.mode,

    m.qty_change,
    m.note,

    u.email as actor_email,
    m.created_at
  from public.inventory_movements m
  join public.products p
    on p.id = m.product_id
  left join auth.users u
    on u.id = m.actor_user_id
  where m.store_id = p_store_id
  order by m.created_at desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_store_inventory_movements(p_store_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, store_id uuid, product_id uuid, product_name text, sku text, unit text, category text, qty_change integer, mode text, note text, actor_user_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  if not public.has_store_access(p_store_id) then
    raise exception 'Not authorized for this store';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    im.id,
    im.store_id,
    im.product_id,
    coalesce(p.name, 'Product') as product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.unit,
    p.category,
    im.qty_change,
    im.mode,
    im.note,
    im.actor_user_id,
    im.created_at
  from public.inventory_movements im
  left join public.products p
    on p.id = im.product_id
  where im.store_id = p_store_id
  order by im.created_at desc
  limit p_limit
  offset p_offset;
end;
$function$
